request_json.name: plant_id

request_json.name: idempotency_key
request_json.title: idempotency_key
request_json.description: 16-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 : _ - generated by the form once per submission (stable across double-clicks, refreshes and resubmits of the same content; regenerated only after the job for the current key is FAILED or CANCELLED)

request_json.name: payload
request_json.title: payload
request_json.description: the CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM payload (JSON text or object): { command, header: { delivery_no, plant_id, customer_name, delivery_date, ... }, lines: [ { stable_line_key, material_id, gd_order_uom_id, gd_qty, temp_qty_data: [ { location_id, gd_quantity } ], ... } ] } - scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs gdPayloadShape

request_json.name: confirmation_hash
request_json.title: confirmation_hash
request_json.description: optional: the required_confirmation_hash the form got back on an AWAITING_CONFIRMATION job (64 lowercase hex); stored on the existing job of the same key and payload

request_json.name: correlation_id
request_json.title: correlation_id
request_json.description: optional: 1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 | : . _ - (defaults to the idempotency key)

request_json.name: payload_hash
request_json.title: payload_hash
request_json.description: optional echo: when given it must equal sha256Hex(canonicalJson(payload)) (PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID otherwise)

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.idempotency_key,
       j.job_status,
       j.payload_hash,
       j.confirmation_hash,
       j.progress_message,
       j.row_version,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.idempotencyKey}}'
